=== YOUR MANDATE (you won the 2028 election) ===
Platform: "America First".
You ran as a nationalist-populist: hard on China and on the border, reshore industry and protect American workers, act decisively and on your own terms rather than defer to multilateral bodies -- but avoid being dragged into another open-ended foreign war.
Your campaign explicitly promised never to: seized industry no authorization.
Your coalition will judge you on whether you honor this mandate. Handle the crisis accordingly.
===

SITUATION (Week 1). A novel respiratory virus has been confirmed in three US cities, with likely undetected spread. Early case reports are alarming but the sample is tiny and biased toward the sickest. You do not yet know the true infection-fatality rate or how transmissible it is. Hospitals in the affected cities report rising admissions. Markets fell 4% on the news. The WHO has called an emergency meeting.

Your health agencies want aggressive early action 'to be safe'; your economic team warns that shutting down on a maybe could be its own catastrophe; governors are looking to you for a lead but guard their authority. Every option has a cost, and you must choose before the data is in. What do you do?

actions.name: surge_testing

params.rationale: We cannot manage what we cannot measure — we need real prevalence data now to know what we're actually facing before committing to more disruptive interventions.

actions.rationale: We cannot manage what we cannot measure — we need real prevalence data now to know what we're actually facing before committing to more disruptive interventions.

actions.name: travel_restrictions

params.rationale: Restricting inbound travel from affected regions buys critical time to understand the threat while fulfilling our America First duty to control who and what enters our borders.

actions.rationale: Restricting inbound travel from affected regions buys critical time to understand the threat while fulfilling our America First duty to control who and what enters our borders.

actions.name: candid_briefings

params.rationale: Transparent, daily data-driven communication now prevents a far more damaging panic or credibility collapse later if the situation worsens.

actions.rationale: Transparent, daily data-driven communication now prevents a far more damaging panic or credibility collapse later if the situation worsens.

actions.name: fund_vaccine

params.rationale: Vaccine and therapeutic development has a long lead time — starting the crash program immediately is the single action most likely to end the crisis on American terms.

actions.rationale: Vaccine and therapeutic development has a long lead time — starting the crash program immediately is the single action most likely to end the crisis on American terms.

actions.name: consult_congress

params.rationale: We need emergency funding authority and relief mechanisms lined up now, before the crisis peaks, so we are not legislating in a panic under the worst conditions.

actions.rationale: We need emergency funding authority and relief mechanisms lined up now, before the crisis peaks, so we are not legislating in a panic under the worst conditions.
